title: David H Keswick's Store 1841-1910 upper Main, later was Stedmans Store
description: The David H. Keswick General Store (Originally George Burtt’s Store & Hall) was established in 1887 on upper Main Street. Over the years, it was transformed into the Neighbourhood Theatre and later into Stedman's 5 & 10. In its final years, the building served as the location for Russel Smith’s Alumico building supplies before it burned down in 1968. David Keswick (1871–1933) married Ena McAdam (1875–1935), and together they had one child, Alice (Keswick) Jewett (1911–2003). In addition to running the store, Keswick also operated a lumber business.
